# Edmonton Tamil Catholic Family (ETCF)

> A Tamil-speaking Catholic community based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, gathering for Tamil Holy Mass, prayer, fellowship and family faith formation. Online family resources are available to Tamil Catholic families across Canada.

ETCF's local community is in Edmonton. Its gathering place is St. Theresa's Catholic Church, 7508 29 Avenue NW, Edmonton, AB T6K 3Y8, Canada. Other parishes linked in the Canada guide are independent communities.

General enquiries: info@edmontontamilcatholics.ca. Telephone: +1-780-607-1212.

The homepage's published upcoming event details and annual calendar provide dates and times. Schedules can change; check the current event details before travelling. Gallery photos and older schedules are not confirmation of a future Mass date. Kids Corner is currently in beta.

## Main pages

- [Edmonton Tamil Catholic Family | Tamil Mass & Community](https://www.edmontontamilcatholics.ca/): Join Edmonton Tamil Catholic Family for Tamil Mass, prayer and community in Edmonton, Alberta. Explore Catholic family resources for Tamil Canadians.
- [Tamil Catholics in Canada | Mass & Family Resources | ETCF](https://www.edmontontamilcatholics.ca/tamil-catholics-canada.html): Find Tamil Catholic community links in Edmonton and Canada, official parish and diocese information, and Catholic resources for children and families.
- [Catholic Kids Activities & Tamil Family Resources | ETCF](https://www.edmontontamilcatholics.ca/kids-resources.html): Explore Bible games, prayers and Catholic family activities from Edmonton Tamil Catholic Family, welcoming Tamil families across Canada. Kids Corner is in beta.
- [Tamil Catholic Community Photos in Edmonton | ETCF Gallery](https://www.edmontontamilcatholics.ca/gallery.html): Explore photos of Tamil Catholic worship, celebrations and community life with Edmonton Tamil Catholic Family in Alberta, Canada.
